newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 13.
newsitem.headline: MALAYSIA STOCKS - factors to watch - May 13.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Malaysian stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average soared 123.22 points or 1.72 percent to close at 7292.75.
* The Kuala Lumpur Composite Index previously slumped 18.85 points or 1.70 percent to 1,088.52.
* Ringgit quoted at 2.5108/13 a dollar at around 0030 GMT, after ending Kuala Lumpur trading on Monday at 2.5085/95.
* Power utility Tenaga Nasional reported above-forecast half-year net earnings to 511 million, boosted by a 4.0 million ringit in foreign exchange gain.
* Property developer Westmont Land said it was involved in negotiations for the sale of its power barge projects to a public listed company
* On Tuesday, Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad will witness the signing of underwriting agreement of Bakun Hydro-Electric Corp initial public offering at 1100 local time (0300 GMT).
